[b]11th March - 3:00am HST+1[/b]

The SRS Tyrant Echo sits in the middle of the Baliwick sea, waiting to pounce on its prey. Over the past three days, High Command has been supplied with the routes and locations of various Orphogronian uranium shipments. Captain Asad stands at the controls, waiting for the word from the lookouts.
[i]"I see them sir! I see them!"[/i] shouts a young man from behind. Asad chuckles and takes them in. A small cargo ship sails in front of them. Asad admits to himself it is rather underwhelming. He was expecting a huge Vessel, not this tiny thing. Nevertheless, they quickly got to work. The  Tyrant Echo speeds towards it with frightening force and hits the side of the ship with a loud thud. A team of 40 soldiers immediately boards the ship and begins the search. They split up, 20 to find the uranium, 20 to find the crew. The crew are soon in the custody of the Sal-Baliz, taking only 7 minutes to round up the entirety of the ships personnel. Finding the uranium is a trickier task, but within 20 minutes it too has been found. The ships crew are swiftly taken back to the Tyrant Echo and held in a makeshift prison cell. Then, the team regroup to begin the task of hauling the uranium aboard. The uranium is first taken up to the top deck, where four people are required to lift a container. After 38 minutes of work, the uranium is secured. The last thing to attend to is the crew. Asad decides the best thing to do is to drown them, so each member of the team grabs a crew member by the legs and begins dipping them in the water. After 11 minutes they are silently sinking into the depths of the Baliwick sea, never to be seen again. The operation was quick, silent and efficient, but the sun was beginning to rise. On the horizon a lookout sees a ship approaching quickly. It is hard to tell what kind of ship it is, but it is clearly military. The SRS Tyrant Echo quickly starts up its engines and speeds its way home
